findings.claim: The new naming guard test will fail because CLAUDE.md still contains a non-allow-listed Lovable reference.
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md adds/keeps the sentence "the Lovable scaffolding has been removed"; src/test/brand-naming.test.ts scans CLAUDE.md in SCANNED_PATHS and asserts offendingLines(/lovable/i) equals [], with no ALLOWED pattern for Lovable; constraint tests-pass requires `npm test` to pass.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the Lovable reference from CLAUDE.md or add a deliberate allow-list entry if the reference is intended.

findings.claim: The standalone chat welcome KnowMe mark is rendered without an accessible name despite the brand-identity requirement.
findings.evidence: brand-identity spec says the mark SHALL have an accessible name; KnowMeMark defaults to `aria-hidden="true"` when no `label` is supplied in src/components/brand/knowme-mark.tsx, and the chat welcome renders `<KnowMeMark size={32} />` without a label.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the standalone welcome mark as `<KnowMeMark size={32} label="KnowMe" />` or wrap it in an equivalently named accessible element.
